New plan: 

My poem was too long and repetitive, which made it lose its impact. I should have focused on a more concise and meaningful message. I also didn't effectively highlight the pros and cons of playing video games, which was the main task. Next time, I will aim to write a poem that is around 20-30 sentences long, with a clear structure and a balance of both the advantages and disadvantages of playing video games. I will also make sure to use more creative and effective ways to highlight the key points, such as using italics, bold, or underlining to draw attention to the most important phrases.
